"""Protocol-level tests: interactivity, overlong lines, EOF, contamination."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, select, copy

BASE = {"epoch": 7, "node_count": 4,
        "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4},
                  {"tail": 1, "head": 2, "capacity": 4},
                  {"tail": 0, "head": 2, "capacity": 2},
                  {"tail": 2, "head": 3, "capacity": 3},
                  {"tail": 0, "head": 3, "capacity": 8}],
        "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 3, "demand": 5,
                         "paths": [[0, 1, 3], [2, 3], [4]],
                         "previous": [8, 4, 4]}],
        "failed_edges": [1], "budget": 6}

prog = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/app/submission/planner.py'
fails = []


def expect(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        fails.append(msg)
        print("FAIL:", msg)
    else:
        print("ok:", msg)


# ---- 1. interactive line/response protocol ------------------------------
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, prog], stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=0)
line = json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n"
p.stdin.write(line); p.stdin.flush()
t0 = time.time()
resp = p.stdout.readline()
dt = time.time() - t0
r = json.loads(resp)
expect(r["status"] in ("optimal", "infeasible"), "interactive first response %.3fs" % dt)
# second request
b = copy.deepcopy(BASE); b["epoch"] = 99; b["budget"] = 0
p.stdin.write(json.dumps(b).encode() + b"\n"); p.stdin.flush()
resp2 = p.stdout.readline()
expect(json.loads(resp2)["epoch"] == 99, "interactive second response")
# malformed line then valid line
p.stdin.write(b"garbage!!!\n"); p.stdin.flush()
resp3 = p.stdout.readline()
expect(json.loads(resp3) == {"status": "invalid"}, "malformed line -> invalid")
p.stdin.write(json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n"); p.stdin.flush()
resp4 = p.stdout.readline()
expect(json.loads(resp4)["status"] in ("optimal", "infeasible"),
       "valid after malformed")
p.stdin.close()
rc = p.wait(timeout=30)
expect(rc == 0, "clean exit on EOF (rc=%d)" % rc)
err = p.stderr.read().decode()
expect(err == "", "no stderr noise: %r" % err[:200])

# ---- 2. overlong lines -------------------------------------------------
payload = json.dumps(BASE).encode()
LIMIT = 4 * 1024 * 1024
pad_ok = LIMIT - 1 - len(payload) - 1     # content + newline == LIMIT
big_ok = payload + b" " * pad_ok + b"\n"
expect(len(big_ok) == LIMIT, "boundary line is exactly 4 MiB (%d)" % len(big_ok))
big_bad = payload + b" " * (pad_ok + 1) + b"\n"
data = big_bad + b'{"epoch":1,"node_count":1,"edges":[],"commodities":[],"failed_edges":[],"budget":0}\n' + big_ok + json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n"
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, prog], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
rows = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
expect(len(rows) == 4, "overlong consumed, 4 responses (%d)" % len(rows))
expect(rows[0] == {"status": "invalid"}, "overlong -> invalid")
expect(rows[1].get("status") in ("optimal", "infeasible"), "after overlong ok")
expect(rows[2].get("status") in ("optimal", "infeasible"), "4MiB-1 line accepted")
expect(rows[3].get("status") in ("optimal", "infeasible"), "final line ok")

# a truly huge line (16 MiB) must also be consumed
huge = payload + b" " * (16 * 1024 * 1024) + b"\n"
data = huge + json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n"
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, prog], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
rows = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
expect(len(rows) == 2 and rows[0] == {"status": "invalid"}, "16 MiB line handled")

# ---- 3. final line without newline, blank lines ------------------------
data = b"\n" + b"   \n" + json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n" + b"  \t \n" + json.dumps(BASE).encode()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, prog], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
rows = [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
expect(len(rows) == 5, "blank/whitespace/final lines -> 5 responses (%d)" % len(rows))
expect(rows[0] == {"status": "invalid"} and rows[1] == {"status": "invalid"}
       and rows[3] == {"status": "invalid"}, "blank lines invalid")
expect(rows[2].get("status") in ("optimal", "infeasible"), "mid line ok")
expect(rows[4].get("status") in ("optimal", "infeasible"), "eof line ok")
expect(p.returncode == 0, "rc 0")

# ---- 4. empty input ----------------------------------------------------
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, prog], input=b"", capture_output=True, timeout=60)
expect(p.returncode == 0 and p.stdout == b"", "empty stdin ok")

# ---- 5. lots of requests ----------------------------------------------
reqs = []
for i in range(64):
    b = copy.deepcopy(BASE); b["epoch"] = i; b["budget"] = i
    reqs.append(json.dumps(b).encode() + b"\n")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, prog], input=b"".join(reqs), capture_output=True, timeout=300)
rows = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
expect(len(rows) == 64, "64 requests answered (%d)" % len(rows))
expect(all(json.loads(r)["epoch"] == i for i, r in enumerate(rows)), "epochs echoed")

print("FAILURES:", len(fails))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python3 proto_tests.py
